title: Lane E0: Frontend Systems Atlas and Dual Static-Site Surface Architecture

sections.title: Lane E0 — Frontend Systems Atlas
sections.summary: Establishes the first governed frontend architecture foundation for Rig Relay: a transcript-grounded Frontend Systems Atlas, a three-surface architecture model (Gridline Interface, Project Page, Portfolio Site), and a typed surface specification contract for future compiler and desktop projection consumers.

cards.title: Frontend Systems Atlas (atlas.py)
cards.body_html:
Transcript-grounded design principle ingestion model. Accepts Pixelgrid UI transcripts (or any design-research corpus) and extracts structured, traceable frontend design principles with provenance, visual/interaction grammar, and explicit applicability to all three Rig Relay surfaces. No principle is promoted to canonical product truth until implemented and proven.

Key models: AtlasPrinciple, AtlasDigestResult, VisualGrammarImplication, InteractionGrammarImplication, SurfaceApplicability.

Source

cards.title: Three-Surface Architecture Model (surfaces.py)
cards.body_html:
Typed architecture model defining three distinct application surfaces: Gridline Interface (native desktop, live, internal-only), Per-Repository Project Page (static, public-safe, single-project evidence portal), and Developer Repository Portfolio Site (static, public-safe, cross-project case study site).

Key models: SurfaceSpecification, ThreeSurfaceArchitecture, FrontendSurfaceKind, RequiredSection. Includes shared vs distinct element classification.

Source

cards.title: Surface Specification Contract (contract.py)
cards.body_html:
Compiler-facing typed contract making the three-surface distinction machine-legible. Defines distinct projection roots, reader goals, publication safety rules, and content-light enforcement. Provides sample project-page and portfolio-site projections with deterministic digests. Not a mock UI or design document — a typed boundary for future implementation.

Key models: SurfaceSpecificationContract, ProjectPagePublicationProjection, PortfolioSitePublicationProjection, PublicationSurfaceKind.

Source

cards.title: Three JSON Schemas
cards.body_html:
• rig.relay.frontend_design_principle.v1 — Schema for transcript-derived frontend design principles with source provenance
  • rig.relay.frontend_surface_specification.v1 — Schema for the compiler-facing surface specification contract
  • rig.relay.publication_projection.v1 — Schema for dual publication projection with conditional required sections per surface

sections.heading: Three Surface Distinction
sections.body_html: The architecture explicitly prevents collapsing project-page and portfolio-site into one generic site generator. Project page answers 'what is true about this system?' Portfolio site answers 'what does building this system demonstrate about the developer?' They share design tokens, rendering primitives, and evidence cards but have distinct reader goals, navigation, projection inputs, and publication policies.

sections.heading: Transcript Ingestion Readiness
sections.body_html: The atlas digestion pipeline is fully implemented (AtlasDigestResult, AtlasPrinciple, compute_atlas_digest_id, principle_is_traceable) and schema-backed. As soon as transcript digestion begins, each extracted principle carries source identity, transcript SHA256, visual/interaction grammar implications, and explicit surface applicability. However, no actual Pixelgrid UI transcripts have been processed into design principles in this E0 pass. The corpus of 44 transcripts is available at .build/pixelgridui-transcripts/ and is structurally ready for ingestion in a follow-on lane.
